Research digest

North warehouse pilot: spoilage dropped after sensor calibration. The team noted that the first pass over-reported freezer alarms.

Austin warehouse pilot: deployment blocked by vendor firmware, replacement boards, and a delayed maintenance window.

Action item: update the risk register after the vendor confirms the revised firmware date.
